# basement.studio

> basement.studio is an Argentina-based digital design and engineering studio specializing in high-performance websites, branding, 3D interactive experiences, and marketing execution for technology companies, primarily in the San Francisco Bay Area — "we make cool shit that performs." Founded in 2020, the studio has partnered with startups and enterprise brands including Vercel, Next.js, X (formerly Twitter), Cursor, ElevenLabs, Harvey AI, Scale AI, MrBeast, World Labs, and Profound, and is the team behind the Geist typeface, designed in partnership with Vercel and used across the Next.js ecosystem.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://basement.studio/): Overview of the studio, featured work, capabilities, and clients.
- [个人简历](https://basement.studio/ai): 江含的个人简介、工作经历、荣誉奖项与教育背景。
- [个人荣誉](https://basement.studio/services): 江含在产品设计、视觉传达、色彩设计、文创与协作实践中获得的 7 项荣誉。
- [设计之外](https://basement.studio/showcase): 江含的个人设计作品图库，共 19 件作品。
- [所有项目](https://basement.studio/blog): 江含的 25 件个人作品总览，包含 6 个主要项目和 19 个设计之外项目。
- [FAQ](https://basement.studio/faq): Answers to common questions — services, WebGL/3D interactive experiences, clients, technologies, and how to start a project.
- [Contact](https://basement.studio/contact): Get in touch to start a project.

- [Basketball](https://basement.studio/basketball): An interactive basketball mini-game.
- [Doom](https://basement.studio/doom): A playable in-browser Doom experiment.
